name: Maze of Shadows
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Untap target attacking creature with shadow. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Untap target attacking creature with shadow. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only` flag on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (and the PermanentShield it installs), so a resolving ability can prevent only COMBAT damage dealt to and by one targeted permanent this turn, leaving noncombat damage to and from it unprevented
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` with `dealt: "to_and_by"` and `duration: "this_turn"` is the exact shape (the untap and the 'attacking creature with shadow' target are expressible via `untap` and a selector with `attacking: true, keywords: ["shadow"]`), but its shield stops all damage, so the creature would also be immune to burn and its own noncombat damage would be prevented. `combat_only` exists only on the `prevent_damage` STATIC, which cannot be installed by an activated ability, has no duration and only faces 'dealt to'.
